title: Unusual behavior: Cat becomes aggressive and chases girl after she teases him
description:
This girl playfully passed by her cat named Sun, gently teasing him and expecting a fun response.

However, Sun wasn't in a playful mood at all. Instead of joining in the fun, his reaction took a turn.

It was as if he decided to teach her a lesson for her mischief. Suddenly, Sun became aggressive and began to chase her.

As the chase unfolded, he pounced at her with his paws, showing a side of him that was quite unusual.

The girl ran around nervously as she tried to escape his playful wrath.
Location: Vimercate, Italy
